title: Replication package for: Revealing the Subsidy: Competitive Allocation of Concessional Finance in Fragile States
description: Code, frozen inputs, outputs and verification records for the numerical exercises (participation, selection and posted-offer comparisons under the LPVS contract), the concessionality exhibit built from IDA Private Sector Window disclosures, and the Scaling Solar participation table of the CGD Working Paper "Revealing the Subsidy".
